name: Interlink
description: Interlink is a web-based, multi-tenant recruitment management platform designed to streamline and automate hiring processes. It centralizes candidate data, reduces manual workload, and improves decision-making through AI-driven features.
core_features: AI-powered CV screening and candidate ranking
benefits: Reduces hiring time and manual effort

technology.ai: AI APIs for CV analysis and evaluation

goal: To provide an intelligent, scalable, and user-friendly recruitment platform that improves hiring efficiency and decision quality.
